sourceTitle: Heart Utterances at Various Periods of a Chequered Life
description: "Heart Utterances at Various Periods of a Chequered Life" by Eliza Paul Gurney is a collection of poems written in the early to mid-19th century. The work captures the author's reflections on life, love, loss, and spirituality, showcasing the emotional trials and joys experienced throughout her journey.
